$comment: Localization overlay for src/manifest.json. build.js applies the selected language over the source manifest; anything not listed here falls back to the source value.

description.zh: 锚点收缩形变：画面向可移动锚点收缩，边缘固定不撕裂（全部固定 / 不固定=AE 鱼眼），收缩强度随半径沿可编辑的贝塞尔曲线插值。
description.en: Anchor-point shrink: the image contracts toward a movable anchor while the edges stay pinned and tear-free (all pinned, or unpinned = AE fisheye). Strength interpolates by radius along an editable Bezier curve.

zh: 圆形·AE 白点（钉四角，边可弯）
en: Circular · AE white dots (corners pinned, edges bend)
